tldr: Uranus through the 8th house disrupts shared money, trust, intimacy, dependency, and control.
body:
When Uranus moves through your 8th house, it interrupts the usual pattern around shared money, debt, trust, intimacy, dependency, fear, grief, and what is hard to control. You may notice where trust, money, attachment, or vulnerability is carrying more weight than usual.

You may need more space, honesty, freedom, experimentation, or a break from the old setup. It can help you see where the current pattern has become too small or too false.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for getting honest about what is shared, owed, feared, or avoided.

The caution: Watch for changing everything just to get relief from one pressure point. The risk is trying to control what actually needs a clearer agreement or a more truthful conversation.

Uranus moves through this house for a long chapter. Give change room without throwing away the parts of life that still matter.
